selection: Held-out validation selection from saved accepted candidates before benchmark scoring.
success_rule: Chamfer times 1000 <= 10; no missing or extra joints; paired joint type score 1, axis error <= 10 degrees, pivot error <= 0.1 when defined. Range error is the mean of available paired joint range errors and is not part of this success rule.

gpt54_film_rerun.scoring_note: Canonical Real2Code metrics with 100,000 sampled points per mesh. test-34 Params used 24 workers for exact cKDTree queries; metric definitions and sample count are unchanged.
gpt54_film_rerun.selection: Held-out validation selection from saved accepted candidates before benchmark scoring.
gpt54_film_rerun.fitting: Harness-owned trajectory fitting with a finite collision prior. Geometry and initial poses are fixed for Params; only its joint limits are fitted.
gpt54_film_rerun.playback: Saved fitted joint positions at the observed film timestamps. The observed film and both GPT-5.4 film panels share the middle calibrated camera. Other panels retain their archived range sweeps.

gemini_film_protocol.comparison_note: These searches use fit-on-evaluate at 1e71675. Archived GPT-6 film searches used 05fe792, with ten connect fits run after selection.
